svg.desc: Restoration of Al-Mahrouqi House and the Facade of Al-Arabi Mosque LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Ministry of Antiquities and Tourism STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress 250,000 EGP DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This 8-month project, initiated in 2024 by the Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities, focuses on the restoration of Al-Mahrouqi House and the facade of Al-Arabi Mosque in Historic Cairo. It involves detailed historical, architectural, and structural studies, alongside planning for precise heritage restoration. The scope also includes modernization of utility systems and the preparation of comprehensive tender and cost documentation for implementation.
